name.value: North Surrey Sport and Ice Complex

description.value: North Surrey Sport & Ice Complex is a City of Surrey municipal recreation facility housed in a three-storey building in the Whalley area. It offers public drop-in skating, dry floor programs, fitness classes, and weight room access to residents and visitors. A touring cyclist seeking an active rest day could use the skating or fitness facilities here.
